passives.name: Prelude of the Waning Crescent
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases Critical Damage of the caster, and reduces Critical Hit Chance of Fire, Water, and Earth enemies. These effects cannot be removed. Increases the effectiveness of increased stat effects on the caster by [Buff_V_4076009_4_5]. When attacked, does not take Weakness Gauge damage if the caster does not have a debuff. Recovers [Buff_V_4076009_4_3] Weakness Gauge upon scoring a critical hit on an enemy. Increases damage taken from Light enemies and reduces damage dealt to them. Against non-Light enemies, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], increases damage dealt, and reduces damage taken.
